primitives.name: Isolated Internal Automation Lab
primitives.verbatim_quote: # NEXT-013: n8n isolated internal automation lab ## Repo(s) n8n ## Category Automation ## Goal Implement or design the n8n isolated internal automation lab capability for GSE / GSN without touching production data first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L': 'Automation lab isolation level (dimensionless)', 'D': 'Data access control depth (dimensionless)', 'P': 'Production data touch flag (binary)'}
primitives.assumptions: The automation lab operates in a sandboxed environment with no direct access to production systems or sensitive data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P=1, system enters unauthorized operational mode.

layer2.mapping: The automation lab mirrors GSE's operational logic but abstracts away production dependencies using a controlled simulation layer.
layer2.telemetry: Change detection in file system, environment variables, and workflow execution logs.

primitives.name: Evidence-Based Workflow Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why It Matters This increases GSE's ability to operate autonomously, learn from users, improve conversion, reduce SaaS cost, and make product/marketing decisions from evidence.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'Evidence strength (dimensionless)', 'C': 'Conversion rate improvement (dimensionless)', 'S': 'SaaS cost reduction (currency/unit time)'}
primitives.assumptions: Workflow outcomes can be quantified and correlated with business metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E < threshold, workflow is flagged for re-evaluation.

layer2.mapping: Automated workflows generate empirical feedback loops that refine GSE’s decision-making process.
layer2.telemetry: Conversion tracking, cost per acquisition, and A/B test result variance.

primitives.name: Legal Compliance Boundary Enforcement
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Legal / License Boundary n8n: Sustainable Use License for non-ee code; source-available/fair-code, not normal OSI OSS; ee files require enterprise license Do not copy source code from these repos into GSE.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L_c': 'License compliance status (binary)', 'R': 'Reproduction risk index (dimensionless)', 'A': 'Asset usage authorization (binary)'}
primitives.assumptions: All code assets must adhere to defined licensing terms to prevent legal exposure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R > threshold or L_c = 0, access is denied.

layer2.mapping: GSE enforces legal constraints on codebase access similar to how n8n enforces its own license model.
layer2.telemetry: Code integrity checks, license validation reports, and asset access logs.

This ensures that automation workflows remain decoupled from live environments. Evidence-based optimization (E) is derived from workflow performance metrics, which map to conversion improvements (C) and SaaS cost reductions (S). These are governed by a probabilistic model that updates based on observed outcomes. Legal compliance (L_c) acts as a binary constraint on asset usage (A), preventing unauthorized reproduction of proprietary code. The interplay between these primitives forms a closed-loop system where autonomy is maintained through formalized boundaries and validated learning.
